recognize_zh: 母細胞 gate 的 CD117 對 CD34 流式圖：大多數母細胞 CD34 陰性到弱，CD117 從陰性到約 10^4 連續性部分表現；另有一小群 CD34 強陽性、CD117 部分陽性的細胞。
features: Dot plot gated on blasts: CD117-APC (x) versus CD34-PC7 (y), log scales
Dominant population CD34 negative to dim (<10^3)
CD117 heterogeneous, negative to dim-moderate (up to ~10^4) on the dominant population
Minor CD34-bright (~10^4) subset with variable CD117, including CD34+CD117+ cells
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of the blast gate displays CD117 versus CD34. Most blasts are CD34 negative to dim with heterogeneous dim-to-moderate CD117 expression, and a minor CD34-bright subset shows variable CD117. Partial CD117 expression supports an immature myeloid-associated phenotype but is not lineage defining. Findings are compatible with the myeloid-associated component of the reported mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid; myeloid lineage assignment requires MPO or monocytic differentiation markers.

ddx.vs: AML lacks the strong CD19 with CD79a, CD22 or CD10 required for the B component, which must be evaluated on other tubes.
B-ALL may express CD117/CD13/CD33, but without MPO or monocytic differentiation it is not MPAL.
ETP-ALL is also CD117/CD34 positive but expresses cytoplasmic CD3 and CD7, which are not features of B/myeloid MPAL.
